credits.title: Mina's Red Kite
credits.author: WordLight project
credits.attribution: Test story and pictures made for WordLight (original, for development and rehearsal).

pages.text: Mina has a red kite. The wind is soft and warm.
Mina runs up the green hill. Her kite goes up and up.
A big bird flies near the kite. Look at the bird!
The sun goes down. Mina and her kite go home.
